caption: The drawing depicts a large piece of cream or light beige fabric with visible folds and drapes, occupying the central rectangular space of the artwork. The fabric has a subtle pattern of diagonal lines and small diamond shapes, and is adorned with regularly spaced small floral motifs. Each floral motif consists of clusters of red, blue, yellow, and green colors, standing out against the lighter background. The fabric is rendered to show the play of light and shadow across the folds, suggesting depth and texture. The scene is framed by a wide, plain beige border, and there is a signature with a date visible near the bottom right corner inside the bordered area. No other objects or figures are present in the composition.
title: Dress Material
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
